plan.goal: Log in as standard_user, add Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart, checkout with the entered name and zip code, and complete the order.

steps.note: Password entry is masked and not legible in the recording; login page states the password for all users is secret_sauce and login succeeds.
The Add to cart button under Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99), the first product shown.
Cart icon at top right; named by its stable part Cart, badge changes after adding.
Placeholder label not legible after entry; first field on Checkout: Your Information.
Placeholder label not legible after entry; second field on Checkout: Your Information.
Zip digits are partially obscured by the Zip/Postal Code placeholder in the recording; value shown as read.
Continue on Checkout: Your Information proceeds to the overview page; that intermediate page is not clearly shown, frames jump to Complete.
Finish button visible at bottom of final frame on overview; clicking it shows Checkout: Complete.

Back Home on Checkout: Complete returns to the inventory page so the next row's Add to cart can be found; without it the next iteration looks for Add to cart on the checkout-complete page and fails. Cart is empty after the order.

plan.expected_effect: After the final row's Finish shows Checkout: Complete with 'Thank you for your order!', Back Home returns to the Swag Labs inventory page showing Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and other products, with an empty cart, ready for the next row; each order before returning home is complete with Price Total $32.39, Payment Information SauceCard #31337, and Shipping Information Free Pony Express Delivery!.
